SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES




                            SOAH ORDER NO. 15
            RESCHEDULING PREHEARING CONFERENCE AND
                         HEARING ON THE MERITS


      A prehearing conference is scheduled on June 8, 2026 at 9:00 a.m., and the
hearing on the merits commences at 1:00 p.m. that same day. To make best use of
hearing time and facilities, the Administrative Law Judges determined that a
prehearing conference in advance of the first day of hearing would be advantageous
 to all parties. Therefore, the prehearing conference is rescheduled to June 5, 2026,
at 1:00 p.m., via videoconference only.


      The hybrid hearing on the merits will begin on June 8, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.,
and resume at 9:00 a.m. each day through June 12, 2026. For those attending in
person, the hearing on the merits will convene at JJ Pickle Research Center,
10100 Burnet Rd., Building 137, Austin, Texas 78758.


      The prehearing conference and online attendance for the hearing on the
merits will convene by Zoom videoconference. Parties shall attend the prehearing
conference and hearing on the merits by videoconference in one of these ways:

  Join by computer or smart device:               Join by telephone (audio only):
  Go to https://soah-texas.zoomgov.com            Call +1 669 254 5252
  and enter the following:                        and enter the following:
  Meeting ID:       161 003 7736                  Meeting ID:             161 003 7736
  Passcode:         PUC6349                       Passcode:               4577035


      If a party experiences technical difficulties with joining any hearing, they
should contact SOAH’s Docketing Division at (512) 475-4993.


      Aaron Edward Howton’s May 8, 2026 motion for continuance and extension
of deadlines by 30-45 days is DENIED. All other pre- and post-hearing requirements
remain as set in SOAH Order No. 6.
